post.originalText:
3/ Ole Lehmann's list of what Opus 5.5 animation is good for was bookmarked 2,100 times this week. Number 8 was animated diagrams. So I asked for one.

One prompt: explain a token bucket rate limiter, canvas only, no libraries, every frame a pure function of time so my renderer can screenshot it.

- 193 seconds, 70 cents, 10K characters of HTML
- The count on screen matches the simulation at every frame. I asked for that and it held
- Same pipeline as every other video in this thread, untouched

This is the b-roll Ole means. It took less time than finding a stock clip.
